game.title: Atomic Heart
game.blurb: First-person shooter set in a retro-futurist Soviet research facility, from Mundfish, released 2023-02-21. RAWG average playtime: 12 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Campaign
chapters.summary: From Chelomey through Vavilov, the train, VDNH, the theater, the hospital and Pavlov to the secret at the heart of it all, plus the Armageddon difficulty.

chapters.title: Boss Fights
chapters.summary: Belyash, Hedgie, Plyusch, Natasha, Dewdrop and the Twins.

chapters.title: Crafting and Upgrades
chapters.summary: Crafting weapons and consumables, polymer jelly, weapon upgrades and skill trees.

chapters.title: Exploration and Secrets
chapters.summary: Phone booths, talking dead, Chirpers, Lootyagins, testing grounds, scanning and Limbo apples.

chapters.title: Combat Feats
chapters.summary: Elemental kills, headshots, telekinesis, vodka, railguns, cars and stopping sprouts.

chapters.title: Annihilation Instinct DLC
chapters.summary: The Annihilation Instinct DLC, its BEA-Ds and NORA, the Strekoza and its new weapons and feats.

chapters.title: Trapped in Limbo DLC
chapters.summary: The Trapped in Limbo DLC: apples, gold coins, the casino and the no-death runs.

chapters.title: The Later Story DLCs
chapters.summary: The two later story add-ons the achievements call "the story DLC": underwater areas, secret rooms, CHAR-les and the figurines.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0, marked "Perfect stub article"); it links Gameplay, Walkthrough and Table of Contents subpages, but none of them exists, so nothing was used. atomicheart.fandom.com answers the API with about 109 linked articles, including "Annihilation Instinct", "Enchantment Under the Sea", "CHAR-les", "Chelomey Complex", "Vavilov Complex", "Pavlov Complex", "VDNH" and "Facility 3826"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. Steam app 668580 is the base game (the other match is "Atomic Heart 2"). Only 1 of 82 Steam achievements is hidden ("Overkill", 1.1%); it sits in the Trapped in Limbo chapter because it falls inside that block of the Steam list. RAWG lists the add-ons "Atomic Heart: Annihilation Instinct", "Atomic Heart: Trapped in Limbo" and "Atomic Heart: Blood on Crystal" (2026) as separate entries. The Annihilation Instinct and Trapped in Limbo achievements are named in the descriptions; the ones with no add-on named ("Weird Science" to "Maximum Strength", and "Moby Dick", "Master of Survival" and "Demonstration of Violence") are grouped by their place in the Steam list and their low unlock rates. Two achievements say "Complete the story DLC" ("And now—CHAR-les" and "This Is the End"), so the later story add-ons share one chapter; the data does not say which achievement belongs to which add-on. "Apple Pie" (pick all apples in Limbo) sits in the base-game part of the list, so it stays in exploration.
